notes: Observation well in the Putah Creek channel; no owner or well name printed, so water_source gives the creek whose stream-surface altitude the table also records (choice not covered by the rules). Heading prints '8/1W-23C1 (18.2)'; the 18.2 is not explained on this page. Columns: altitude of ground water (water_level), altitude of stream surface (elevation; 'Dry' on many dates), difference (computed). Year 1951 from the column heading 'Date (1951)'. Remarks for Apr. 24: 'Well completed this date'. Other location words: 400 feet west of irrigation well 8/1W-23B1, north side of low-water channel. Area from the running head 'WATER-LEVEL MEASUREMENTS--PUTAH CREEK'; no county or state printed.
